name: What is the difference between renovating a single-family home and a multifamily property?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between renovating a single-family home and a multifamily property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary differences lie in scale, complexity, and impact. Multifamily remodeling involves multiple units and common areas, requiring coordination across numerous stakeholders (owners, tenants, HOA). It often necessitates stricter adherence to commercial building codes, ADA compliance, and fire safety regulations, which can differ from single-family residential codes. The project timeline is typically longer, and the focus extends beyond individual aesthetic preferences to enhancing property value for investment and tenant retention. Logistics for materials and trades are also more intricate in a multifamily setting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Multifamily remodeling differs from single-family in scale, complexity, and impact, involving multiple units, stricter codes, longer timelines, and a focus on investment value and tenant retention.
